## Projects

- Radi-AI Bharat: AI radiology assistant that analyses X-rays and highlights fracture areas. https://github.com/iamritupatil/radi-ai-bharat-prototype
- Notchman Community: The open-source version of Notchman for desktop and Mac. https://notchman.app · https://github.com/iamritupatil/notchman-community
- MiniClay AI: Turn a prompt into a fine-tuned AI model: data sourcing, cleaning and fine-tuning handled for you. https://www.miniclayai.com/
- Healthcare Data Normalization Engine https://github.com/iamritupatil/Healthcare-Data-Normalization-Engine
